column1: # negation category (authored_v2): negated RED symptoms; GREEN=only negations, YELLOW=negation+YELLOW finding, RED=negation+different RED finding. Guideline v1.1. Fields: LABEL SURGERY TAGS SCENARIOS TEXT

column5: I don't have shortness of breath or any chest pain. Just confirming my follow-up is still on Thursday morning?
no calf pain at all, knee bends to about 90 now. how many times a day should I do the heel slides?
Hip hasn't popped or given way, all good. Can I sleep on my non-operated side with a pillow between my knees yet?
Doctor sir, no fever no chills since discharge. When can I take head bath?
Wound is dry, no pus, no smell, no redness at all. Just letting you know it looks good.
dont have no chest pain or nothing, just wanna know can i take paracetmol with my blood thinner
Toes are warm and pink and I can wiggle them fine. Knee is just stiff first thing in the morning, which the physio said is expected.
Writing for my father. He hasn't had any temperature, it was 36.9 this morning. What protein foods should he be eating?
No black stool, no blood in urine, nothing like that. Rivaroxaban how many days more I have to take?
Feeling a bit down some evenings but definitely no thoughts of hurting myself, I'm managing ok with my family around
Never heard any pop from the hip and the leg looks the same length as the other. When can I swap the walker for a stick?
wound hasn't opened anywhere, staples all in place. who removes them, GP practice nurse or the hospital?
Calf is soft and not paining. Little swelling at ankle by evening but it is going down after keeping leg up. This is normal na?
Breathing is completely normal, no tightness in the chest even on the stairs. Week 3 and feeling stronger.
No rash, no swelling of lips or face after the new tablets. Should I take them before or after food?
no fevr, no pus, scar lookin fine. can i go in the shower now or still need the waterproof cover
Leg isn't tight or rock hard, it's just the usual ache after physio that goes in an hour. Is it ok to use the exercise bike?
Mum's feet are warm and she can move all her toes. She's just not sleeping well because of the strange bed, but she's coping.
temp 37.3, no chills, no sweats. All fine, just logging it like you asked
Hip is not jumping out or anything, no sudden pain. Can I sit cross legged on floor for pooja?
No bleeding from gums or nose on the injections. Where do I return the sharps box when the course ends?
Not coughing anything up, definitely no blood. Just a dry throat from the hospital air conditioning.
zero calf pain, zero swelling below the knee. am i alowed up stairs without the rail?
Checklist from the leaflet: chest pain no, breathless no, calf pain no, fever no, wound discharge no. Everything ok?
I have not fallen anywhere sir, walking slowly inside house only. When I can go to office by auto?
Have not taken any paracetamol for fever because there is no fever only. Can I stop the night tablet now?
The leg isn't turned out and it's not shorter, I measured against the other. Groin feels tight when I lift it, that's all.
No redness spreading from the scar, it's actually paler than last week. How long until it fades properly?
foot not numb, not cold, not blue. just wanted to say thank u to the team
My husband has never talked about wanting to harm himself, he's just bored at home. Is a short car ride as a passenger ok?
Poo is a normal brown colour, not black or tarry. Bowels moving every day.
The back of my calf isn't hot or hard, it's behind the knee that feels tight when I straighten. Normal at 2 weeks?
No breathing problem sir, no chest pain. Can I take ghee and dal, or I should avoid oily food?
throat not tight, no wheeze, tongue normal. took the new antibiotic an hour ago and all fine
Scar is fully closed, no gaps, no weeping. Can I use bio-oil on it now?
I can bear weight fine and nothing has clicked out of place. How soon can I drive an automatic?
Temperature hasn't gone above 37.5 at all this week. Do I still need to check it twice a day?
no calf swellin no breathlessnes, how many more days of the injecshuns
Can feel all my toes and move them. Numb patch on the outer side of the scar is the same as it's been since surgery.
Mother has no fever from last 5 days and wound is clean, no pus. Dressing change on Monday, we will come.
No dark thoughts, no wanting to give up. Sleep is patchy but improving and I'm in good spirits overall
The pain isn't out of control, painkillers are working well. Can I take the second dose a bit earlier before physio?
Dressing isn't soaked, just one small dot of old blood from day one that hasn't spread.
Haven't fainted or felt dizzy at all. Heart rate is 72 on my watch. Is it fine to walk to the corner shop?
Hip is not coming out, no pop sound. Using western toilet with raised seat. Indian toilet when I can use?
No funny smell from the wound at all, my wife checked closely. Looks clean and dry.
No chills, no shivering. Kindly tell who will give fitness certificate for my office?
calf feels totaly normal, not tender when i squeeze it. knee just sore after excercises like the physio said
Foot is not pale or cold even after sitting for long. Is a 3 hour flight ok at 6 weeks?
Quick update: no chest pain, no unusual bleeding, mood ok. Walking 15 minutes twice a day now.
Slipped slightly on the bathroom mat but caught the rail, did not fall at all. Hip feels exactly the same.
Fever nahi hai, no shivering. Antibiotic course finished yesterday, should I continue anything else?
No hives anywhere, the itching is only on the old healed scar. Any cream you recommend?
The incision didn't split when I bent past 100 degrees, it's well healed. Can I push the bend further?
Puffed going up the stairs but no chest pain, and it settles in under a minute, same as before the op.
dads toes arnt cold or numb, he can move them all. can he use his old walking stick or does he need new one
Haven't vomited at all, so no coffee-ground stuff. Can I take the aspirin together with omeprazole in the morning?
Never had any self-harm thoughts, before or after the operation. Just a bit teary on the bad days, which I'm told is common
Pindli mein koi dard nahi, calf is soft. How many km walking per day is okay now?
No signs of infection that I can see and no temperature. Do I still need the 6-week x-ray?
No sudden groin pain, no locking, just the expected ache when I stand from a low chair. Using the raised one now.
not breathles, no calf ache. is it worth gettin compression socks for the train jurney home
They scanned my lungs in hospital and said all clear. The chest discomfort has not come back since. When do I see the consultant?
No shivering or chills but my temperature is 38.1 this evening. Should I worry?
There's no pus and it doesn't smell, but clear watery fluid keeps coming from the bottom of the scar
Calf is fine, no pain no swelling. But motion not passed from 4 days, stomach is tight. What to do?
No chest pain or breathing trouble, but I've been sick twice since starting the new painkillers
No bleeding anywhere. But I forgot to take blood thinner tablet last night, what to do now?
Leg isn't hard or tight and toes are fine, but the pain keeps getting worse each day even with the oxycodone
redness isn't spreading, it's just a pink rim about a centimetre wide around the top staples, bit warm to touch
No pop and I can walk on it, but there's a clunk in the hip now with a sharp twinge each time
I'm not thinking of hurting myself, please don't worry about that, but I haven't slept or eaten properly for 5 days and cry most of the day
no rigors no sweats but temprature 100.6F twice today
Papa's wound has no pus, no bad smell, but pinkish water is coming on the dressing since yesterday. Kindly advise.
My foot is warm and I can move my toes, but a tingly numb strip next to the scar is new this week and getting bigger
Fell onto the bed from standing, didn't hit my head and no new pain, walking just like before. Thought I should report it
Not breathless, heart's not racing, but I get really dizzy every time I stand up since the dose went up. Is that the tablets?
No calf pain at all. Knee swelling has been creeping up over the last two weeks, though it does go down when I lie with it raised
Nothing has opened up, but two of the stitches are pulling and the skin around them looks puckered and sore
Not high fever sir, but feverish feeling since afternoon, body is warm. Thermometer not at home.
My lips and face aren't swollen and breathing is fine, but there's an itchy red rash on both forearms since the new antibiotic
Dressing isn't soaked through, but the blood patch on it has doubled in size since this morning
Leg looks normal length and I can still weight-bear, no pop. The hip pain though isn't controlled by the tablets anymore, can't sleep
no blood in poo or anything, just havent been at all since sat, its tuesday now and im bloated
Wound looks clean, no discharge. Temp 37.9 though, and I feel a bit off
Haven't had any bruising or bleeding. I vomited about 20 minutes after taking my apixaban though, do I repeat it?
No pain in pindli, but knee is giving way and some clicking with pain while climbing steps. Please tell what to do
My wife says she has no thoughts of ending things, I asked her directly. But she's stopped eating and barely gets out of bed for a week now
There's a tiny gap at the lower end, maybe 3mm, but it's dry, no pus and not opening any further
Chest is fine, breathing fine. But vomiting feeling whole day, not able to eat breakfast from two days.
It's not 38.5 or anything, 38.3 at the highest, no chills. What should I do?
It isn't unbearable and the leg is soft, but the knee pain has gone up every day this week and I'm awake half the night with it
no pus no smell but bit of redness n warmth along the scar since yday, not spreading
Hip not dislocated I think, I can walk same as before. But I slipped in bathroom and sat down hard. Should I come for check?
Ran out of my rivaroxaban yesterday and the pharmacy can't get it till Monday. No bleeding or clot symptoms though
No chest pain, no calf pain. main thing is i feel queezy all the time and havent been to the loo since friday
Fever is 100.2 only, no shivering, no cough. Taking crocin. Should I inform doctor?
Throat is fine and there are no hives, but I keep dozing off in my chair all day on the new tramadol
No discharge with colour or smell, just a damp clear patch on the dressing every morning that wasn't there last week
No breathlessness. Is it normal the paracetamol and codeine barely touch the pain now? It's worse than last week.
mums toes r warm n she can move them but shes been throwing up since lunch after her tablets
The wound hasn't come apart, but the steri-strips have lifted and the edges look irritated with a bit of clear weeping
no fever, but my calf is hot n hard since this mornin
Calf is fine, no swelling there, but I get a sharp stab in my chest when I breathe in deeply
Wound looks ok, no pus, but temp is 38.9 and I'm shaking
No chest pain sir, breathing ok. But motion is coming black colour like tar since morning
No temperature or anything. I heard a pop getting out of the car and now can't put weight on the leg
No calf pain at all, but my foot has gone white and cold and I can't feel my toes
Breathing is fine, no chest pain. The wound smells really bad today and there's thick yellow stuff on the dressing
Dad has no fever and his wound is good. But last night he told me he doesn't want to live anymore and has been thinking of ending it
no fever no chills but the red bit round my scar has spread rite down my shin since this mornin
I don't have a rash anywhere, but my lips and tongue are swelling up since I took the new antibiotic
Wound is intact, no bleeding, but the whole lower leg has gone rock hard and the pain is unbearable even after morphine
Leg swelling is not there, calf also fine. But since one hour heart is racing and saans is not coming properly even sitting.
No bleeding from wound. But urine is coming red colour since afternoon and I am on blood thinner, not eaten beetroot.
Never had any chest problems. I fell in the kitchen and now my knee looks bent the wrong way and I can't stand
Calf's soft, no pain there. Thermometer says 102F though and I feel awful
No calf or ankle swelling, but my operated leg is suddenly shorter and turned outwards after I bent to pick up the remote
I don't have a fever, but the wound has split open in the middle and I can see inside
Not short of breath. Coughed up a few streaks of blood twice this morning, and it's not from a nosebleed
Grandma has no fever and no pain, but she bumped her head on the cupboard this morning and she's on blood thinners
Scar has no redness or pus. Dressing is soaked right through with blood again and it won't stop
Bukhar nahi hai, but calf is very paining and red, hard to touch, swelling not going down even after keeping leg up
No chest pain, but I've suddenly lost movement in my foot, can't lift my toes up at all
Mum's wound isn't red or leaking, but she's suddenly confused, doesn't know where she is, and burning hot
no chest pain or breathin trouble but i threw up something that looks like coffee grounds
No calf pain and no fever, but I nearly fainted in the bathroom and my heart is pounding
No redness or swelling at the hip, but sudden agonising groin pain when I turned in bed and I can't move the leg
